title: USMLE Step 1 integrated review
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
purpose: Review the foundational sciences by system with board-style questions: biochemistry, genetics, immunology, microbiology, pathology and pharmacology principles, every organ system, behavioral science, ethics and biostatistics.
primary_reading: USMLE: Step 1 content outline and sample questions

weeks.1: The exam blueprint and study planning
weeks.11: Behavioral science, ethics and biostatistics review
weeks.12: Mixed question blocks and error repair

blocks.deliverable: Build a study plan from a diagnostic block.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Week 7 midterm; complete a mixed block under time.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Complete a full mixed block and repair your weakest system.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Self-assessment cycle: complete supplied mixed blocks, categorize every error by system and type, and build a targeted four-week plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
